description.value: The Bent Mast is a casual pub and comfort-food restaurant in Victoria's historic James Bay neighbourhood, housed in a character building dating to 1884 and featured on Victoria's Ghost Walks. Located less than a 10-minute walk from the Inner Harbour, it serves a wide selection of local craft beers alongside its kitchen menu, with a spacious patio and upstairs event rooms. Touring cyclists finishing a ride along the waterfront will find a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere right in the heart of the neighbourhood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides clear confirmation of the business name, address (512 Simcoe St Victoria, BC V8V 1L8), and phone ((250) 383-6000) — OSM lacked a phone number. The 'Order Online' button confirms takeout is available. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; (250) 383-6000 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible pub and restaurant near the Inner Harbour in Victoria — a natural stop for touring cyclists exploring James Bay.
